en.title: Ariana Grande Returns to Final Fantasy Resonance Via Fan Mod
en.summary: A new mod for the upcoming HD-2D RPG, Final Fantasy Resonance, allows players to bring back pop superstar Ariana Grande and other beloved characters. This comes after the game's producer confirmed she would not be featured.
en.body:
Fans of **Final Fantasy Brave Exvius** were disappointed to learn that pop sensation **Ariana Grande**, who made a memorable pixelated appearance in the original mobile title, would not be returning for its spiritual successor, **Final Fantasy Resonance**. Producer Keisuke Nakashima recently confirmed to Kotaku that Grande's character "would not fit within the vibe that we’ve created for Final Fantasy Resonance." However, for those who wished to see the "Dangerous Woman" era icon back in the fold, the modding community has stepped in.

A new mod, dubbed the **Vision Studio** mod, is enabling players to reintroduce **Ariana Grande** and a host of other fan-favorite guest characters into **Final Fantasy Resonance**. This empowers players to customize their party with characters that might have been absent from the official release, including figures like **Sora** from **Kingdom Hearts** and **2B** from **Nier: Automata**. The modding scene has long been a vibrant part of PC gaming, and this development showcases its ability to fulfill player desires and extend the life and personalization options of a game.

## The Modding Community's Touch

The addition of **Ariana Grande** to **Final Fantasy Resonance** is more than just a cosmetic change for some players. Her inclusion in **Final Fantasy Brave Exvius** back in 2017, complete with an outfit inspired by her "Dangerous Woman" era and references to her song "Touch It," was a significant crossover event. For many, these collaborations are a cherished part of the franchise's history. The fact that modders can so readily bring these elements back underscores the passion and creativity within the **Final Fantasy** fanbase, offering a way to preserve and celebrate these unique moments.

## What's Next

**Final Fantasy Resonance** is set to launch on October 22, 2026, for PC, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S. While **Ariana Grande** and other crossover characters are not officially part of the game's roster, the **Vision Studio** mod ensures that players can experience a version of the game that includes them. Further details on the mod's development and potential updates can be found within the modding community.

This situation highlights how, even when official content doesn't align with fan expectations, dedicated communities can find ways to keep beloved elements alive. It's a testament to the enduring appeal of both **Final Fantasy** and its unique collaborations.

content_raw: If you were upset to hear that pop star Ariana Grande wouldn't return in Final Fantasy Resonance , a new mod is here to save the day. In case you were unaware, Square Enix's Final Fantasy Resonance will arrive as the long-running RPG franchise's first proper HD-2D game when it launches next month, and it also happens to be a bit of a remake. The game it's based on, Final Fantasy Brave Exvius , is a free-to-play game with turn-based gameplay that launched for iOS and Android devices in 2015 and shut down in 2025 – but what does that have to do with Ariana Grande? The performer behind hits like "break up with your girlfriend, i'm bored," who also played Galinda in the recent Wicked films, isn't a newcomer for the Final Fantasy series. Grande actually joined Final Fantasy Brave Exvius in the form of pixelated characters – including one fit with her Dangerous Woman era bunny outfit – in 2017. The announcement (below) even detailed some in-game love for the pop star's song "Touch It," but when it comes to Final Fantasy Resonance, Grande's contribution to the series will be lost to time. Producer Keisuke Nakashima recently confirmed to Kotaku that Grande "unfortunately" would not appear in the October Final Fantasy game. At the very least, it sounds like a decision Square Enix put some thought into. "It’s also part of the worldview, you know?" he told the site. "Ariana Grande’s character would not fit within the vibe that we’ve created for Final Fantasy Resonance." Modders, it seems, disagree. As spotlighted by the FFR Vision Studio mod (via Eurogamer ), Grande can feel right at home back in Final Fantasy Resonance along with a collection of other guest characters. That means you can add other names like Sora from Kingdom Hearts and 2B from Nier Automata to join the fight with only a few clicks. FF Resonance Mods by in FinalFantasyResonance Keep in mind that this is all more than one month before the game actually comes out. From Grande to Sora, these characters are only available to join Final Fantasy Resonance as part of its recently released demo. The demo does, however, allow players to carry their progress over to the full release, so it wouldn't be a surprise to see former Final Fantasy Brave Exvius characters show up in the launch build, too. Final Fantasy Resonance launches for PC, Nintendo Switch, Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S October 22, 2026. Until then, you can check out IGN's final preview for the game .
